The workshop

Our workshop in Haifa

Everything is made here, in our workshop on Arye Shenkar Street in Haifa — design, cutting, assembly and spray finishing — and then installed by us.

Equipment

Machine room

Panel saw, thicknesser, planer, bandsaw and router table for accurate, repeatable milling of solid timber and sheet goods.

SCM Minimax edgebander

Applies edge banding to cabinet panels, here in the workshop.

Blum hardware systems

Blum drawer systems and fittings, fitted to our cabinets.

Fuji D6 HVLP spray system

A six-stage HVLP turbine system for spray finishing.

Raptor downdraft spray booth

An enclosed spray booth with filtered airflow from ceiling to floor.

Busellato Jet Optima RT CNC nesting machine — arriving soon

Purchased for the workshop and not yet installed.

Spray finishing

Sprayed in-house. Start to finish.

  • Raptor downdraft spray booth with glass double doors, a downdraft grated floor, a digital control panel and filtered airflow from ceiling to floor.
  • Fuji D6 6-stage HVLP turbine system.
  • 2K polyurethane coatings, applied and cured in a controlled environment.
